title: Siemens SENTRON PAC3200 Power Monitoring Device
description: Baseline model for the Siemens SENTRON PAC3200 power monitoring device (Ethernet Modbus TCP; Modbus RTU through the optional PAC RS485 expansion module), read over Modbus. Register map: SENTRON PAC3200 Manual 02/2008 A5E01168664B-04, section 3.9.3 'Modbus measured variables with the function codes 0x03 and 0x04', Table 3-6, PDF pages 42-45. The manual lists each value by an 'offset' and does not state the address on the wire. The Siemens application example 'Data Exchange between S7-1200 and SENTRON PAC via MODBUS TCP (Set 22)', Entry ID 40614428 V14.0, Table 3-12 on PDF page 26, reads the PAC3200 total active power (offset 65) with MB_DATA_ADDR 40001 + 65 = 40066, and the Siemens document 'Modbus/TCP with MB_CLIENT and MB_SERVER', Entry ID 102020340, Table 4-5, PDF pages 23-24, maps MB_DATA_ADDR 40001 to the holding register at remote address 0. So the offset is the zero-based address on the wire: offset 1 (the voltage Va-n) is address 1, and address 0 is not used. The LOGO! application example, Entry ID 109779762, PDF page 13, enters 'Register 2' for the offset 1 value, which agrees with a one-based register display. Registers are read with function code 03 (04 returns the same data); a read must start on the first register of a value. Float values are IEEE 754 in two registers, unsigned long values in two registers and double values in four registers; the manuals do not state the word order, and the Set 22 example reads the two registers of the active power directly as an S7 Real, which means the first register holds the high word. The model reads the high word first for every multi-register value, and no device was read on hardware. Left out: the maximum and minimum values, the parameter change counters and the limit violation counter, the settings and the command parameters, and the device information blocks.
